case_narrative_summary: Around 1:56 a.m. on Saturday, January 18, 2020, KCPD officers responded to a reported shooting in the 8400 block of East 109th Terrace (near 109th Terrace and Marsh Avenue in the Ruskin Hills/Ruskin Heights area of southeastern Kansas City, Missouri) and found an 18-year-old Black male, publicly identified as Bobby Joe Bernard Wallace (Bobby J. Wallace), lying on the ground with a gunshot wound. He was transported in extremely critical condition to a local hospital, where he died in surgery that same day (KCMO's 8th homicide of 2020). KCPD's 2020 offense snapshot contains 9 involvement rows for KC20004297: 1 deceased victim (VIC DEC B/M/18), 3 non-deceased victims (VIC B/M ages 47, 53, and null), 4 arrest/charge suspect entries for a 19-year-old Black male (ARR CHA SUS, CHA SUS, and inactivated charge code CHA INA), and 1 unknown-race male suspect (SUS); however, public searches of Jackson County Prosecutor releases and local media found no publicly named defendant or homicide indictment.

case_narrative_summary: Shortly before midnight on Sunday, January 19, 2020 (reported at 23:27), 29-year-old Jahron Swift opened fire on a line of patrons waiting to enter the 9ine Ultra Lounge nightclub in the 4800 block of Noland Road in Kansas City, Missouri, during a celebration following the Kansas City Chiefs' AFC Championship victory. Patron Raeven A. Parks (25, Black female) was fatally shot, at least 15 other people were injured, and an armed private security guard employed by the lounge fatally shot Swift outside the business. KCPD's 20-row offense record for KC20004714 carefully distinguishes Raeven A. Parks as the sole 'VIC DEC' (B/F/25, row 211), codes deceased gunman Jahron Swift as 'VIC SUS' (B/M/29, row 132), records 17 non-deceased 'VIC'/'CMP VIC' rows, and includes 1 'ARR OTH SUS' row (M/38, row 42) for a collateral arrest.

case_narrative_summary: At approximately 7:33 a.m. on Sunday, February 2, 2020, KCPD officers responded to E. 9th Street and Hardesty Avenue in Kansas City, Missouri, where they discovered the smoldering, burned body of 31-year-old Derrick L. Wallace (Black male, DOB 05/08/1988) on top of a shopping cart in an abandoned homeless camp. Although KCPD's initial offense row recorded firearm_flag='false' due to the burned state of the body, the Jackson County Medical Examiner's autopsy on February 3, 2020 recovered .380-caliber bullets, determined the cause of death to be multiple gunshot wounds (noting skull fractures likely from thermal injury while not ruling out blunt force trauma), and ruled the death a homicide; detectives determined Wallace was shot and struck with a machete 4-5 days earlier at 5209 Independence Ave #2. On June 22, 2020, Jackson County prosecutors charged Mark S. Salisbury (W/M, DOB 04/25/1979) in KC20008191 (Prosecutor No. 095458988) with 2nd-Degree Murder, Armed Criminal Action, and Unlawful Possession of a Firearm.

case_narrative_summary: Just after 1:00 a.m. on Friday, February 7, 2020 (reported at 01:07), KCPD officers responded to the 3200 block of Independence Avenue on a report of a man carrying a rifle, located 37-year-old Joshua Downing (White male) in the street at E. 6th Street and Gladstone Boulevard, and commanded him to drop the weapon. After less-lethal beanbag rounds failed to disarm him, officers followed Downing on foot to E. 8th Street and Gladstone Avenue in Kansas City, Missouri, where multiple KCPD officers fatally shot him when he turned and pointed his rifle at them; he was pronounced dead at an area hospital. In Socrata vsgj-uufz, KC20009618 is coded under NIBRS 09C ('Officer Involved Shooting - Fatal' / 'Justifiable Homicide') with 1 deceased suspect row ('SUS DEC' W/M/37, row 32) and 7 involved-officer rows ('VOD' / 'VOD SWM'), placing it in the separate fatal-police-shooting / 09C justifiable homicide category rather than 09A criminal murder.

case_narrative_summary: On Monday, June 22, 2020 (reported at 09:56), KCPD officers responded to a domestic disturbance and reports of gunshots at a residence in the 9400 block of NE 91st Street in the Clay County (Northland) portion of Kansas City, Missouri (ZIP 64157). Following a multi-hour standoff, officers entered the home and found married couple Jamie Lynn Williams (48, White female) and Damone E. Williams (45, Black male) both dead from gunshot wounds; investigators determined that Damone Williams fatally shot his wife Jamie Williams before taking his own life. In Socrata vsgj-uufz, KC20041259 contains both 09A Murder rows (rows 225 and 389) and excluded 09D 'DV Related Suicide' rows (rows 72 and 295) for the pair; separating 'VIC DEC' (Jamie Lynn Williams, 1 included 09A homicide victim) from 'SUS DEC' (Damone E. Williams, 09D suicide offender) prevents double-counting the perpetrator's suicide as a homicide victim.
